assumptions.statement: Official regulatory, property, heritage, road, rail, water, municipal, fire, and engineering controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory, parcel, capacity, demolition, construction, or implementation conclusion is made; official data requires complete recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Repository provisional polygons are used only as rough constraints for intake and internal geometry checks.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios have low confidence and cannot describe existing conditions or official controls.

assumptions.statement: No authorized field site, representative public-use baseline, or real low-use claim is asserted.
assumptions.impact: Observation coverage and low-frequency task-loss metrics remain unknown; prototypes use synthetic scripts only.

assumptions.statement: Ordinary-task equivalence requires co-review by affected users and accessibility/community professionals.
assumptions.impact: The concept cannot claim equal service, inclusion, or successful access before independent task testing.

assumptions.statement: No restoration time or closeout performance has been observed.
assumptions.impact: Restoration metrics remain unknown and expansion is prohibited until a bounded authorized trial proves removability.
